cost_fixture_sha256_encoding: Canonical-LF UTF-8 (universal-newline text encoded as UTF-8); timing_json_sha256 remains the raw archived receipt byte hash
measurement_kind: Per-unit test-body time from all four complete-accounted workers, not completion-log deltas
caveat: Historical advisory costs only. Failed paths may understate passing runtime; no current qualification or wall-time improvement is implied.
inventory_policy: All 68 historical measurements retained. These are scheduling weights, never a selected-test inventory. Unknown units retain runner fallback.
method_shard_policy: The checkpoint parent cost is measured; its seven method costs are not. The reviewed runner temporarily divides this parent hint equally and reports those methods as uncosted until actual method receipts exist.
qualification_policy: The historical run failed. No current green gate, per-method measurement, end-to-end speedup or sub-30-minute completion is claimed.
